description: Look up a research paper on arXiv, by bare arXiv id (e.g. "1706.03762") or by keywords/title, and return its metadata plus two separate lists: `paperLinks`, the datasets named in the paper's own text (each with the matched catalog archive, if any, how it was matched, and a one-sentence summary of how the paper uses it, written by the extraction model and not a quote), and `suggestedArchives`, catalog archives found by a keyword search on the paper that the paper itself does not mention. Only `paperLinks` are evidence that the paper used a dataset. Lookup is arXiv-backed: DOIs, "arXiv:"-prefixed ids, and papers that are not on arXiv do not resolve.

query.description: Bare arXiv id (e.g. "1706.03762"), or keywords/title to search arXiv. Not a DOI.

name: lookup_paper
title: Look up an arXiv paper
